name: review-desk
description: Review agent-written pull requests beside the code: what changed, what the checks found, and what's left for you.

reviewDesk.repository.markdownDescription: The repository to review, as `owner/name`. Leave empty to use the open folder's GitHub remote. When several folders are open, Review Desk asks which one and remembers your pick.

reviewDesk.label.markdownDescription: Only show pull requests with this label. Leave empty to show every open pull request.

enumDescriptions: Claude Code if it's installed, then VS Code's chat, then the clipboard
VS Code's chat, in agent mode (Copilot or another chat agent)
Copy the prompt to paste into any agent
reviewDesk.agent.markdownDescription: Where **Fix with agent** sends a failing check. The prompt is filled in, not sent, so you can read it first.
